## README.md
# EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification

![remote-sensing](https://img.shields.io/badge/remote--sensing-blue) ![sentinel-2](https://img.shields.io/badge/sentinel--2-blue) ![land-cover](https://img.shields.io/badge/land--cover-blue) ![land-use](https://img.shields.io/badge/land--use-blue) ![machine-learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/machine--learning-blue) ![deep-learning](https://img.shields.io/badge/deep--learning-blue) ![earth-observation](https://img.shields.io/badge/earth--observation-blue) ![copernicus](https://img.shields.io/badge/copernicus-blue) ![europe](https://img.shields.io/badge/europe-blue)

EuroSAT is a land use and land cover classification dataset. The dataset is based on Sentinel-2 satellite imagery covering 13 spectral bands and consists of 10 LULC classes with a total of 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images. The dataset is associated with the publications "Introducing EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification" and "EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification". This catalog contains the multi-spectral version of the EuroSAT dataset, which includes all 13 Sentinel-2 bands in the original value range.

## Processing Notes

Multispectral version containing all 13 Sentinel-2 bands in original
value range (not scaled/clipped like RGB version).

Bands (Sentinel-2 order):
  B01: Coastal aerosol (60m)
  B02: Blue (10m)
  B03: Green (10m)
  B04: Red (10m)
  B05: Vegetation red edge 1 (20m)
  B06: Vegetation red edge 2 (20m)
  B07: Vegetation red edge 3 (20m)
  B08: NIR (10m)
  B08A: Narrow NIR (20m)
  B09: Water vapour (60m)
  B10: SWIR - Cirrus (60m)
  B11: SWIR 1 (20m)
  B12: SWIR 2 (20m)

All patches resampled to 10m resolution, 64x64 pixels (640m x 640m).
Coordinate system: WGS 84 / UTM zones (varies by tile location).
